mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 5 trading days indicates imminent monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS over 5 days are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month CPI index increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, triggering monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with CPIAUCSL rising >0.5% in 3 months are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 60 trading days indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with both HOUST and RSAFS rising are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness suppresses wage growth and inflation, supporting stable equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 20 trading days indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 2.0% signals strong economic expansion, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with GDPC1 growth >2.0% annually are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment (UNRATE) over the past 20 trading days indicate labor market tightening, accelerating wage growth and inflation, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with both PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), active monetary tightening increases the risk-free rate, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in high-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
